title: Parking Changes at Balboa Park Starting March 2
description:
More free parking is now available in Balboa Park for City of San Diego residents, starting today! 

Make sure you verify your City of San Diego residency online ahead of time, and then you can access the free Resident Level 2 and 3 parking passes to park for FREE in 7 Balboa Park parking lots. The pass is available per vehicle and is valid for 3 years. There is a one-time $5 registration fee to cover the cost of processing the applications; this fee is not collected by the City. 

In premium (Level 1) parking lots, verified City residents qualify for half-off parking rates. Three hours of free parking is available for everyone at Lower Inspiration Point (including non-City residents), and there’s a free tram available to transport you to the center of Balboa Park. 

Verifying residency online requires you to upload a driver’s license, utility bill, property tax bill or rental agreement, and it may take a few business days to process, so plan ahead! Go to sandiego.thepermitportal.com. 

Balboa Park’s maintenance and operations are funded through the City of San Diego’s General Fund.
